keep.text: Jo aap abhi sunne waale ho na, usne meri poori life badal di.
Ek secret hai jiske baare mein kisi ne baat nahi ki.
Teen din tak khaana band kariye,
72 hours only.
Aur aapki body mein aisa magic hoga ki aap log soch bhi nahi sakte ho.
Chauthe din hoga
aapka brain turn on.
Aur uske baad jo maza aayega aap logon ko, ki aap log soch nahi sakte ho.
Ab do cheezein hoti hain 72 hours ki fasting ke baad.
Pehli cheez hoti hai ki autophagy activate hoti hai, but CMA waali autophagy, normal autophagy nahi. CMA yaani ki chaperone-mediated autophagy, jo ki body ki deep cleaning karti hai.
Normal autophagy mein body randomly damage clean karti hai, but CMA mein
ek protein hota hai, HSC70, specifically,
jo purane kharab proteins ko dhoondhta hai,
aur phir usko
LAMP-2A receptor par le ke jaata hai, aur phir lysosome mein phenk deta hai. Poori ki poori cheezein destroy kar deta hai, aur poori deep cleaning ho jaati hai.
Number two.
Teen din mein glucose poora ka poora khatam ho rakha hota hai, body ka. Body fat tod rahi hoti hai, energy
fat se bana rahi hoti hai, aur fat ki energy bahut zyada hoti hai. Aap log itna jaaga hua feel karoge na, jaise lag raha hoga ki aap caffeine pee karke jee rahe ho.
Aur jab body
fat tod rahi hoti hai, toh liver aapka ketones banata hai,
aur specifically BHB ketone banata hai, yaani ki beta-hydroxybutyrate.
Ab BHB blood brain barrier ko cross karta hai, brain ko
ek directly signal pahunchata hai.
Aur brain isko
glucose se zyada efficiently use kar leta hai.
Aur yahi reason tha, jab maine
72 ghante ki
water fasting ki thi,
then I was super awake, I was more energetic, I was
like
taking a few shots of caffeine.
Mujhe aisa lagta tha ki mere andar kitni zyada energy ho gayi hai,
balki maine kuch khaaya bhi nahi, phir bhi.
Aur ye bhookh nahi thi, ye ek evolution tha. Aur hunting ke time par brain jaise sharp hota hai, waise sharp ho jaata hai aapka 72
hours ki fasting ke baad.
Aur itna sharp agar brain nahi raha, toh kaise shikaar kar paoge?
Kaise success paa paoge apni zindagi mein?
Jab maine teen din ki fasting pehli baar ki thi, toh honestly
main bata raha hoon aap logon ko, do din bahut mushkil hua tha mujhe. Teesre din ekdam magic shuru ho gaya: clarity, focus, energy, saari cheezein badh gayi.

Ab main monthly ek baar toh teen din ki fasting karunga hi karunga, chahe kuch bhi ho jaaye. CMA activate karunga, deep cleaning karunga apni poori body ki, zombie cells poore ke poore maar doonga apne.
Aur ye maine apne saath pran le liya hai. 110 kilo se
85 kg ka ho gaya main, sirf aur sirf forty
five days mein.
Ho sakta hai aap logon ko lag raha hoga ki ye safe nahi hai, aisa karna nahi chahiye.
But main aap logon ko bata raha hoon,
fasting se jitna maza aaya na mujhe,
aaj ke baad
main kabhi kisi ko ye nahi kahunga ki fasting buri hai, kuch na kuch kha lo.
Har ek cheez mein fasting aapki help karti hai.
Aap diabetes patient ho,
toh bhi aap logon ka sugar bahut zyada girega nahi, agar fasting aap log sahi tareeke se karna jaan gaye.
But
ye teen din ki fasting seedha mat kar lijiyega aap log.
Main aap logon ko bata raha hoon, fasting karne ke liye kuch rules hain,
kuch regulations hain,
usko kis tareeke se karna hai, taaki aapki body ko pata bhi na chale.
Toh ye saari cheezein maine apne health protocol mein bata di hain. Aap logon ko bhi health protocol chahiye,
toh comment box mein likh dijiye HEALTH PROTOCOL.
Mera kaam tha science pahunchana, decision aapka hai. You are watching FitFinfluencer, milte hain next video mein!
